title: refactor(ci): modernize workflows, split lint/test/release, bump actions & deps hygiene
author: Jordan Patel
description: Motivation: Our monolithic .github workflows have drifted and the build matrix wastes runner time and cache stability. This PR splits the large CI workflow into focused reusable workflows (lint, test, build, release), standardizes cache keys, bumps GH Actions and action versions for security fixes, and cleans up various dependency-related CI steps. Goals: 1) reduce redundant work between jobs, 2) make lint/test workflows reusable across SDK repos, 3) improve cache hit-rate and parallelism, 4) modernize Node versions used in checks, and 5) make release automation more predictable. Changes in this PR: - Split .github/workflows/ci.yml into .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, build.yml, release.yml and a shared .github/workflows/ci-orchestrator.yml that invokes reusable workflows. - Introduced .github/actions/cache-helpers to centralize cache keys and restore logic. - Bumped actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4 and several community actions to latest recommended versions. - Upgraded Node test matrix to node:18 and node:20 where appropriate and normalized matrix labels. - Reduced duplicated steps across SDKs by introducing reusable workflows with inputs for matrix configuration. - Tightened step timeouts and added explicit cache restore fallbacks. - Fixed flaky lint step by adding explicit eslint cache and pinning ts-node when running type checks. - Updated release workflow to use release-please v12 and added guard rails to prevent duplicate releases during concurrent merges. Checklist: [x] split workflows, [x] bump actions, [x] add reusable workflows, [x] update node versions, [x] update README CI badges, [x] validated in redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-typescript smoke runs. Impact/risk: Low to moderate; CI behaviour changes could surface new cache keys or require consumers to update workflow inputs. Rollout: Gradual merge to main; monitor CI hit-rate and release automation for first 72 hours.
commits: 1) feat(ci): split main workflow into reusable workflows 2) chore(ci): add cache-helpers action and standardize keys 3) chore(deps): bump actions/checkout, setup-node, cache and release-please 4) fix(lint): pin ts-node for deterministic typecheck cache behavior 5) ci: test matrix adjustments and timeout tuning
review_conversation: Riley: Can we ensure the new cache key format still works with our long-tail SDK repos? I ran redwood-sdk-go and saw one miss. Jordan: Yes — added a fallback restore and documented expected cache key format in scripts/ci-utils/cache-key.sh. Priya: release-please v12 has slightly different tag handling, did you validate the tags produced in dry-run? Jordan: yes, ran dry-run against a staging tag repo and confirmed single-tag output; also added guard in release.yml to skip if identical release exists. Marcus: CI times look better but lint flake with esbuild step remains intermittent. Jordan: increased timeout on that step and pinned the esbuild version to a known-good SHA. Approvals: Priya approved after dry-run; Riley requested one small doc update which is included; Marcus gave final approval. Post-merge: I (Jordan) will monitor first 48h and coordinate with infra to revert if we see regressions.
ci_checks: Checks run: lint(matrix on node18,node20) — passing after re-run; unit-tests (python, ts) — passing; integration-tests (smoke) — passed in staged runs; release-dry-run — passed; e2e (optional) — flaky, marked non-blocking. Notable: initial run showed cache misses on redwood-sdk-go due to key mismatch; subsequent commit fixed keys and re-run passed. GitHub Actions summary: 42 total runs for this PR (retries included), final status: all required checks passed.
release_notes: - Split CI into reusable workflows: lint, test, build, release. - Bumped core GH Actions (checkout/setup-node/cache) for security and stability. - Improved cache keys and added fallback restore logic. - Upgraded Node versions in CI matrices. - Hardened release automation using release-please v12.
